character_desc: A dinosaur-bone scientist (a paleontologist) who loves dinosaurs but is not so sure about kids. Two lost grandkids in a broken park are about to change his mind.
actor_facts: He grew up in New Zealand and still lives there, on a farm with its own vineyard.
He names his farm animals after actor friends. There is a pig named after a Jurassic Park co-star.
He came back to play Dr. Grant again in Jurassic World Dominion, 29 years later.

character_desc: A plant scientist (a paleobotanist) who is brave, calm, and not about to wait in the car while someone else does the dangerous job.
actor_facts: Both of her parents were famous movie actors.
She won an Oscar in 2020, and came back as Ellie in Jurassic World Dominion.
She was in Star Wars: The Last Jedi as Admiral Holdo, the one with the purple hair.

character_desc: A mathematician who studies chaos: how tiny changes cause giant surprises. He warns everyone that the park cannot be controlled. Nobody listens.
actor_facts: That famous... way he... talks? A lot of Malcolm's lines were his own improvised twists.
He plays piano in a real jazz band that tours and makes albums.
He has now played Ian Malcolm in four Jurassic movies.

character_desc: The dreamer billionaire who built the park and spared no expense. He wanted to make people happy. His dream just has a few... teeth.
actor_facts: He was a famous DIRECTOR too: his movie Gandhi won 8 Oscars, beating E.T. for Best Picture!
Jurassic Park was his first acting job in 14 years. Spielberg talked him into it.
His brother is David Attenborough, the voice of the world's most famous nature documentaries.
